seo_title: SEBI Fines Brokers Rs 40 Lakh in Axis MF Case
title: SEBI Fines Woodstock and Marfatia Stock Broking Rs 40 Lakh for Facilitating Axis MF Front-Running
court: Securities and Exchange Board of India
case_name: In the matter of Woodstock Broking Ltd., Suresh Jajoo, Marfatia Stock Broking Pvt. Ltd. and Nishil Marfatia (Axis Mutual Fund front-running)
card_summary: SEBI's adjudicating officer held Woodstock Broking and Marfatia Stock Broking liable for facilitating front-running in Axis Mutual Fund trades between April 2021 and March 2022, via a Visa Capital Partners account at Woodstock. It rejected the brokers' defence that they only gave routine brokerage services, and fined the two firms and their directors, Suresh Jajoo and Nishil Marfatia, Rs 10 lakh each.
card_tip: A broker's standard defence that it only executed client orders will not hold once SEBI traces a front-running scheme through linked trading accounts and partnership ties to the firm.
verification_notes: AUDIENCE: domestic (stockbrokers and intermediaries facing SEBI scrutiny over client dealings). TARGET QUERY: not applicable (regulatory order report). DEMAND EVIDENCE: none seen. Confirmed from Moneylife's and LiveLaw Biz's independent reports of the SEBI adjudication order dated 4 November 2026; both agree on the four parties penalised (Woodstock Broking, Suresh Jajoo, Marfatia Stock Broking, Nishil Marfatia), the Rs 10 lakh per-entity / Rs 40 lakh total penalty, the April 2021-March 2022 trading period, the Visa Capital Partners account link and the rejected 'routine services' defence. The underlying SEBI order PDF itself was not opened directly, only the two news reports. REGIONAL FOCUS NOTE: this is a national SEBI order with no Delhi NCR/Kolkata nexus; only one card was written in this run (see commit message for why), so the 'at least 4 of 5 regional' ratio does not apply to this batch.
